title: Chapter 261: Breaking Through Nanshan
content:
Chapter 261: Breaking Through Nanshan

This meeting also virtually eliminated an action that was originally planned to attack Wana Village.

In fact, some of the lords present did intend to attack Wana Village while the village was short of troops.

Then, everyone discussed some details and it was time to distribute the spoils.

In order to avoid unnecessary trouble, Wang Shuo directly asked for the Town Heart of Nanshanji.

After the other lords knew the role of the Town Heart, they all became greedy.

But none of them made any extraordinary moves. After all, Wang Shuo was the absolute main force of this action, and it was good enough for them to get a share of the spoils.

There was no problem for more than 60 lords to gather 500 people each.

Not long after, the army was assembled.

Wang Shuo was naturally the commander of the coalition.

While Wang Shuo and others were meeting, Lin Guanru did not sit still and wait for death.

This was a life-and-death moment, and he did not care about his face.

He immediately sent out a request for help to several nearby system towns.

But strangely, several mayors who were on good terms with him all found excuses to shirk his request for help.

This made Lin Guanru feel hopeless.

At the critical moment, there was not a single reliable teammate.

Outside Nanshanji, Wang Shuo's crossbow battalion was ready.

The catapults fired shells and bombarded the newly built city walls, making a huge explosion.

The durability of the city walls was constantly consumed.

Lin Guanru had no way out.

The current force was not enough to go out of the city to block.

Soon, a section of the city wall was blown down.

Seeing that the time was ripe.

Wang Shuo gave an order.

"Attack."

The coalition forces rushed to Nanshanji like a tide.

At the same time, the bribed gangs also took the opportunity to create chaos in the town.

The defenders of Nanshanji basically did not organize an effective resistance, and the entire town was controlled.

Wang Shuo did not pay much attention to the burning, killing and looting of other lords.

Only Li Weiguo's sword guards were sent to Fuyue Inn to protect Chef Zhang.

The others all followed Wang Shuo into the lord's mansion.

After continuous fighting, only Lin Guanru and Wutuke were left, surrounded.

"Lin Guanru, do you have any last words?" Wang Shuo looked at the besieged Lin Guanru, who was like a stray dog, covered in blood.

"Humph, humph, it's just a matter of success and failure, Wang Shuo, you don't have to be too proud, one day, you will end up like this."

Lin Guanru knew that the situation was over, and countless efforts were once again in vain, and he was filled with grief and anger.

After saying that, he actually drew his sword and committed suicide!

Looking at Lin Guanru's body, Wutuke bared his teeth, and then punched his head several times and committed suicide.

Wang Shuo saw this scene, and felt infinite desolation in his heart.

This may be the final outcome of most people!

Silently picking up their fallen items.

["Territory Governance Strategy" +1, "Xuanmen Sword Skills" +1]

Two books were dropped. Wang Shuo took a look. One was for internal affairs talents to practice. Wang Shuo planned to give it to Duan Wenxi. The other martial arts secret book had no suitable candidate yet.

Without staying too long, Wang Shuo ran straight to the core secret room of the territory.

After continuous attacks, the durability of the protective shield was exhausted.

[You broke through the core of Nanshanji's territory. You can choose to occupy or destroy it. ]

Wang Shuo was a little entangled at this time. The benefits of occupation were undoubtedly huge.

But after thinking for a long time, he still chose to destroy it. He still felt that his Wana Village had a more advantageous geographical location.

Nanshanji had no dangers to defend on all sides. If hostile forces invaded, it would be easily besieged.

And the location of Wana Village only needed to expand the area. Xiangshui River and Wadang Mountain were both natural barriers.

[You obtained the "Heart of the Town", and Nanshanji lost the qualification of a system town. ]
